integrity: Mathematical arguments are self-contained; finite exhaustive checks corroborate but cannot replace the general proof.
scientific_limitations: The numerical rank array and total recurrence are known (OEIS A206306/A007070). Priority is asserted only conditionally for the Catalan-monoid commutation characterization and prescribed-product fibers; unlocated specialized literature could contain equivalent results. The scope is ordered pairs of idempotents, not arbitrary maps or higher tuples.
title: Common-fixed-point compatibility and product-fiber factorization for Catalan monoid idempotents
